annotations.title: Move lists between schema sync scopes

description: Move lists to another schema sync scope, assign unmanaged lists to one, or release them (scope: null), with the indexes the scope manages. Choose lists by id or pathName, or every list of fromScope (e.g. to rename a scope). All or nothing. dryRun defaults to true: show the user the plan, then call again with dryRun: false. Needs the sync-schema permission. 1 request.

fromScope.description: Move every list this scope manages, instead of lists

lists.description: The lists to move, by id or pathName

scope.description: The scope to move them to, or null to release them from schema sync

name: move_lists
title: Move lists between schema sync scopes
